statement: There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way.
explanation: A 2015 study in Nature estimated approximately 3 trillion trees on Earth, compared to an estimated 100–400 billion stars in the Milky Way.

statement: The Amazon rainforest produces 20% of the world's oxygen.
explanation: The Amazon absorbs roughly as much oxygen as it produces through decomposition. The net oxygen contribution to the atmosphere is near zero.

statement: Bamboo is the fastest-growing plant on Earth.
explanation: Certain species of bamboo can grow up to 91 cm (36 inches) in a single 24-hour period under ideal conditions.

statement: The Sahara is the world's largest desert.
explanation: Antarctica is the world's largest desert at 14.2 million km². A desert is defined by low precipitation, not heat and sand.

statement: Peanuts grow underground.
explanation: Peanuts are legumes. After flowering above ground, the plant's ovary pushes into the soil where the peanut pod develops underground.

statement: Bananas grow on trees.
explanation: Bananas grow on large herbaceous plants. The 'trunk' is made of tightly packed leaf bases, not wood, making it a plant rather than a tree.

statement: Strawberries are not true berries.
explanation: Botanically, a strawberry is an 'accessory fruit'. True berries include bananas, kiwis, and avocados, as they develop from a single flower with one ovary.

statement: The rings of a tree always accurately indicate its age.
explanation: While useful, a tree can produce multiple rings in one year if it experiences two growing seasons, and may skip rings in years of extreme stress.

statement: Some species of jellyfish are considered biologically immortal.
explanation: Turritopsis dohrnii, the 'immortal jellyfish', can revert to its juvenile polyp stage after reaching sexual maturity, theoretically cycling indefinitely.

statement: Sunflowers track the sun across the sky throughout their entire lives.
explanation: Only young, growing sunflowers exhibit heliotropism. Once a sunflower matures, it permanently faces east to attract pollinators with morning warmth.

statement: Hawaii moves approximately 7.5 cm closer to Alaska every year.
explanation: The Pacific Plate on which Hawaii sits is moving northwest at roughly 7–9 cm per year due to plate tectonics.

statement: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
explanation: NASA and Chinese astronaut Yang Liwei have confirmed that the wall is not visible from low Earth orbit without magnification.

statement: Pineapples take about two years to grow to maturity.
explanation: A pineapple plant only produces one fruit at a time, and each fruit takes between 18 to 24 months to fully develop.

statement: Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
explanation: Lightning frequently strikes the same location repeatedly. The Empire State Building is struck by lightning approximately 23 times per year.

statement: Mushrooms are more closely related to animals than to plants.
explanation: Genetically, fungi share a more recent common ancestor with animals than with plants, classifying them in their own kingdom: Fungi.

statement: Raindrops are shaped like teardrops.
explanation: Small raindrops are nearly spherical. Larger ones flatten into a hamburger-bun shape from air resistance. The teardrop shape is a myth.

statement: Oxygen is the most abundant element in the Earth's crust.
explanation: By mass, oxygen makes up approximately 46.6% of the Earth's crust, primarily bonded within silicate rocks and minerals.

statement: Cracking your knuckles causes arthritis.
explanation: A study in which a researcher cracked the knuckles of one hand for 60 years found no difference in arthritis rates. The sound is from collapsing gas bubbles.

statement: The loudest natural sound ever recorded was the 1883 Krakatoa eruption.
explanation: The explosion was heard over 4,800 km away and was so powerful it ruptured the eardrums of sailors 64 km from the source.

statement: Water can boil and freeze simultaneously.
explanation: At the 'triple point' of water (0.01°C and 611.73 Pa), all three phases — solid, liquid, and gas — coexist in thermodynamic equilibrium.

statement: The Dead Sea is actually a sea.
explanation: The Dead Sea is a hypersaline lake. It has no outlet, so minerals accumulate, making it about 10 times saltier than the ocean.

statement: Diamonds can be found in meteorites.
explanation: Nano-diamonds have been found in carbonaceous meteorites, formed through the shock of high-velocity collisions in space.

statement: The Earth's core is as hot as the surface of the Sun.
explanation: The Earth's inner core reaches approximately 5,400°C, comparable to the surface temperature of the Sun at around 5,500°C.

statement: All deserts are hot and sandy.
explanation: Deserts are defined by low annual precipitation (under 250mm). Cold deserts like the Gobi and Antarctic are covered in rock, ice, or gravel, not sand.

statement: A day on Earth is exactly 24 hours long.
explanation: A sidereal day — one full rotation relative to distant stars — is 23 hours, 56 minutes, and 4 seconds, not exactly 24 hours.

statement: Antarctica is the largest desert on Earth.
explanation: A desert is defined by low precipitation, not heat. Antarctica receives very little snowfall and covers about 14 million square kilometres, more than the Sahara.

statement: A lightning bolt is several times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
explanation: Lightning heats the air to around 30,000 °C, while the Sun's surface is roughly 5,500 °C.

statement: The Pacific Ocean is larger than all of Earth's land combined.
explanation: The Pacific covers about 165 million square kilometres, more than the roughly 149 million square kilometres of land on Earth.

statement: Coast redwoods are the tallest trees on Earth.
explanation: The tallest known redwood, Hyperion, stands at about 115 metres in California.

statement: The Amazon River carries more water than any other river on Earth.
explanation: It discharges roughly a fifth of all the freshwater that flows into the world's oceans.

statement: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water.
explanation: Oceans make up almost all of it, which is why Earth is sometimes called the Blue Planet.

statement: Only about 3% of Earth's water is fresh water.
explanation: The vast majority is salty ocean water, and most fresh water is locked up in ice caps and glaciers.

statement: The Mariana Trench is the deepest known point in the ocean.
explanation: Its deepest point, the Challenger Deep, lies nearly 11,000 metres below the surface of the western Pacific.

statement: Measured from base to peak, Mauna Kea is taller than Mount Everest.
explanation: Most of Mauna Kea in Hawaii is underwater: from the ocean floor to its summit it is over 10,000 metres tall.

statement: A Venus flytrap only snaps shut when two of its hairs are touched in quick succession.
explanation: This helps the plant avoid wasting energy closing on raindrops or debris rather than a real insect.

statement: Coffee beans are the seeds of a fruit.
explanation: They grow inside red 'coffee cherries' on the coffee plant before being roasted.

statement: Honey can last thousands of years without spoiling.
explanation: Its low moisture and high acidity make it hostile to bacteria, and edible honey has been found in ancient Egyptian tombs.

statement: The Great Barrier Reef is the largest living structure on Earth.
explanation: Made up of billions of tiny coral polyps, it stretches over 2,300 kilometres off the coast of Australia.

statement: Underground fungal networks can connect the roots of different trees.
explanation: These mycorrhizal networks help trees exchange water and nutrients, though scientists still debate how much they shape forest behaviour.

statement: Vanilla comes from an orchid.
explanation: Vanilla is extracted from the pods of the vanilla orchid, and its flowers must typically be pollinated by hand outside their native Mexico.

statement: The Sahara was once green and covered in lakes and grassland.
explanation: Around 11,000 to 5,000 years ago, a wetter climate known as the African Humid Period turned the region lush.

statement: Tides are mainly caused by the gravitational pull of the Moon.
explanation: The Moon's gravity pulls on the oceans, creating bulges that produce high tides as Earth rotates.

statement: Lake Baikal holds about 20% of the world's unfrozen fresh water.
explanation: This Siberian lake is also the deepest on Earth, at over 1,600 metres, and is estimated to be about 25 million years old.

statement: Earth's atmosphere is mostly nitrogen.
explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the air, oxygen about 21%, and the remainder is argon, carbon dioxide and other gases.

statement: Earth is closest to the Sun during the Northern Hemisphere's winter.
explanation: Earth reaches its closest point, perihelion, in early January, which shows that the seasons don't come from distance.

statement: About three-quarters of the world's active volcanoes sit along the Ring of Fire.
explanation: This horseshoe-shaped zone around the Pacific Ocean is also where most of the world's earthquakes occur.

statement: A grove of quaking aspens in Utah called Pando is a single living organism.
explanation: All of its roughly 47,000 trunks are genetically identical stems connected by one root system.

statement: Giant sequoias are the largest trees on Earth by volume.
explanation: General Sherman, in California, is estimated at over 1,400 cubic metres of wood.

statement: The smell of rain after a dry spell has a name: petrichor.
explanation: It comes from oils released by plants and a compound made by soil bacteria called geosmin.

statement: Snowflakes have six-fold symmetry.
explanation: The hexagonal arrangement of water molecules in ice causes snow crystals to grow with six arms or sides.

statement: Thunder is caused by air rapidly expanding around a lightning bolt.
explanation: The extreme heat of lightning makes the air expand faster than the speed of sound, producing a shock wave we hear as thunder.

statement: The Atacama Desert in Chile is one of the driest places on Earth.
explanation: Some weather stations there have never recorded any rain, and parts of it get less than a millimetre in a year.

statement: Botanically, a banana is a berry.
explanation: A true berry develops from a single flower's ovary and has seeds in the flesh, which fits bananas but not strawberries.

statement: Cashew nuts grow outside the fruit they belong to.
explanation: Each cashew nut hangs from the bottom of a fleshy 'cashew apple', and its shell contains an irritating oil.

statement: It takes about 40 litres of maple sap to make 1 litre of maple syrup.
explanation: The sap is mostly water and must be boiled down until the sugar content is concentrated.

statement: Iceland sits on the boundary between two tectonic plates.
explanation: The island straddles the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, where the North American and Eurasian plates drift apart, giving it volcanoes and geysers.

statement: The world's largest single flower, Rafflesia, smells like rotting flesh.
explanation: Rafflesia arnoldii can grow to about a metre across, and its odour attracts the flies that pollinate it.

statement: Lichens are a partnership between a fungus and an alga or bacterium.
explanation: The fungus provides structure and protection, while its partner makes food through photosynthesis.

statement: The Amazon rainforest spans nine countries.
explanation: Around 60% of it lies in Brazil, with the remainder across Peru, Colombia, Bolivia, Venezuela, Ecuador, Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana.

statement: The auroras are caused by charged particles from the Sun hitting Earth's atmosphere.
explanation: Earth's magnetic field funnels these particles toward the poles, where they excite atmospheric gases and make them glow.

statement: Some bamboo species flower only once every few decades.
explanation: Certain species bloom about every 60 to 120 years, and then the whole population often dies back after seeding.

statement: Most of the ocean floor has still not been directly seen or explored.
explanation: More than 80% of the ocean remains unmapped at high resolution and largely unexplored.

statement: The Antarctic ice sheet holds about 90% of the world's ice.
explanation: If it melted completely, global sea levels would rise by roughly 58 metres.

statement: Bristlecone pines can live for more than 4,000 years.
explanation: The oldest known individuals in the western United States are thought to be nearly 5,000 years old.

statement: Water expands as it freezes.
explanation: Ice is about 9% less dense than liquid water, which is why it floats and why frozen pipes can burst.

statement: Chocolate comes from the seeds of the cacao tree.
explanation: Cacao seeds are fermented, dried and roasted before being ground into cocoa.

statement: Mosses have no true roots.
explanation: They absorb water directly through their leaves and use tiny hair-like rhizoids only to anchor themselves.

statement: Seasons are caused by the Earth being closer to or farther from the Sun.
explanation: Seasons are caused by the tilt of Earth's axis, which changes how directly sunlight hits each hemisphere through the year.

statement: Goldenrod is the main cause of hay fever.
explanation: Goldenrod is pollinated by insects and its pollen is heavy and sticky; ragweed, which blooms at the same time, is the real culprit.

statement: Poinsettias are deadly poisonous to humans and pets.
explanation: Poinsettias can cause mild stomach upset or skin irritation, but they are not deadly.

statement: Botanically, a tomato is a vegetable.
explanation: A tomato develops from a flower's ovary and contains seeds, so botanists classify it as a fruit, though cooks treat it as a vegetable.

statement: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth when measured from base to summit.
explanation: Everest has the highest summit above sea level, but Mauna Kea is taller from base to peak, and Chimborazo's summit is farthest from Earth's centre.

statement: Quicksand can pull a person completely under.
explanation: Quicksand is denser than the human body, so a person floats and can usually escape by moving slowly.

statement: You can safely drink the water stored inside a cactus to survive in the desert.
explanation: Most cactus fluid is bitter, can cause nausea or diarrhoea, and is not a reliable source of drinking water.

statement: Carrots were originally orange.
explanation: Early carrots were purple, yellow or white; orange varieties were developed by Dutch growers in the 16th and 17th centuries.

statement: The Earth is a perfect sphere.
explanation: Earth bulges at the equator because of its rotation, making it an oblate spheroid about 43 km wider across the equator than pole to pole.

statement: Humans and non-avian dinosaurs lived at the same time.
explanation: Non-avian dinosaurs died out about 66 million years ago, millions of years before the first humans appeared.

statement: Redwoods are the oldest living trees.
explanation: Redwoods are tall but not the oldest; bristlecone pines and some other species live far longer.

statement: Thunder causes lightning.
explanation: Lightning comes first and heats the air so quickly that it creates thunder. We see lightning before hearing thunder because light travels faster than sound.

statement: Deserts never get any rain.
explanation: Deserts are defined by receiving little rain, usually under 250 mm a year, not by getting none.

statement: Sea water freezes at 0 °C, just like fresh water.
explanation: The salt in sea water lowers its freezing point to around −2 °C.

statement: Rivers always flow from north to south.
explanation: Rivers flow downhill, so many go in other directions; the Nile, for example, flows north.

statement: Antarctica is just a giant sheet of floating ice.
explanation: Antarctica is a continent with land beneath its ice, whereas the Arctic Ocean ice does float.

statement: The North Pole sits on land.
explanation: The North Pole is in the middle of the Arctic Ocean and is covered by shifting sea ice.

statement: Rain is pure water.
explanation: Rainwater contains dissolved gases and particles, and is naturally slightly acidic because it absorbs carbon dioxide.

statement: Scientists can predict exactly when an earthquake will happen.
explanation: Scientists can estimate long-term probabilities for a region, but no one can predict the exact time and place of an earthquake.

statement: All trees lose their leaves in autumn.
explanation: Evergreens such as pines and firs keep their needles year-round and shed them gradually.

statement: Autumn leaves get their yellow and orange colours from pigments newly made in the fall.
explanation: The yellow and orange carotenoids are present all year but hidden by green chlorophyll, which breaks down as autumn arrives.

statement: Seaweed is a type of plant.
explanation: Seaweeds are algae, which belong to different groups than land plants and have no true roots, stems or leaves.

statement: The sky is blue because it reflects the ocean.
explanation: The sky is blue because molecules in the atmosphere scatter short blue wavelengths of sunlight more than longer red ones.

statement: The ocean is blue because it reflects the sky.
explanation: Water absorbs red light more strongly than blue, so the ocean looks blue even though reflection adds some colour.

statement: Glaciers do not move.
explanation: Glaciers flow slowly under their own weight, from a few centimetres to many metres a day.

statement: Hurricanes spin in the same direction all over the world.
explanation: Earth's rotation makes them spin counterclockwise in the Northern Hemisphere and clockwise in the Southern Hemisphere.

statement: Bamboo is a type of tree.
explanation: Bamboo is a giant grass in the Poaceae family, related to wheat and rice.

statement: Almonds are true nuts.
explanation: Botanically, almonds are the seeds of a drupe, related to peaches and cherries, rather than true nuts.

statement: Pineapples grow on trees.
explanation: A pineapple grows from a low, spiky plant in the ground, and each fruit takes months to ripen.

statement: Cranberries grow while submerged in water.
explanation: Cranberries grow on low vines in bogs; the fields are flooded only at harvest time so the floating berries are easy to collect.

statement: Diamonds are made from compressed coal.
explanation: Most diamonds formed deep in the mantle, billions of years ago, long before land plants that form coal even existed.

statement: Forest fires are always destructive for a forest.
explanation: Many ecosystems rely on periodic fires to clear undergrowth and release seeds; giant sequoia and lodgepole pine cones open with heat.

statement: Tides only affect the oceans.
explanation: The Moon's pull also flexes the solid Earth, raising and lowering the ground by tens of centimetres twice a day.
